quote.basis: Native --price on all five actual images; current configured rates and learned image token profiles.
knownLimitations: Heuristic token counts from learned image profiles, not measurements of these new pages.
Default structured output repair can admit two additional billable responses for OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini.
Actual output/reasoning tokens, pricing bands, promotions and tax can change charges.

Mistral OCR 4.0 is deprecated but remains configured; live account/model access is unverified.

approval.scope: The five prepared English clean-typography images across all 22 quoted configured OCR targets; 105 hosted slots and reuse of five local pilot slots.

serializationNotes.origin: Publisher ground truth, never generated from benchmark OCR outputs or consensus.
serializationNotes.blockSelection: For OmniDocBench select one exact page_info.image_path record; retain nonignored top-level title/text_block elements, sorted by numeric order; use parent text once and do not descend into merge_list.
serializationNotes.serialization: Decode literal backslash-t as a tab; preserve actual newlines and punctuation, strip horizontal trailing whitespace from each line; join blocks with two LF; exactly one final LF. No Unicode normalization or lexical editing. Tesseract gold text is copied byte-for-byte.
serializationNotes.typography: Publisher list markers are retained: source hyphens can stand for printed circular/square bullets. Small-caps heading is serialized in the source's uppercase form. Apostrophe variants and spacing before !! follow publisher annotation. These are representation conventions, not strict glyph-level gold.
serializationNotes.exclusions: Decorative artwork, shapes, slide backgrounds/flags and watermark lettering are excluded where absent from publisher annotation; only annotated lexical content is scored.

review.visualReview: All visible text compared against official gold; faithful, no lexical errata found.

localPilot.metricPolicy: Existing consensus OCR lexical normalization; punctuation/case/whitespace differences are not strict glyph accuracy.

spending.costPolicy: Provider-reported usage valued at reviewed rates, settled conservative upper bounds, and unresolved held reservations are separate. Price rows include all settled retry costs and retained reservations once; any conservative component makes the price an upper bound. Accounted cents are not invoice-reconciled charges.

rights.license: Research/noncommercial use only; underlying source-document rights remain separate.
rights.benchmarkPublication: Do not copy image/source text into public benchmark artifacts without a distribution-rights decision; use hashes, project-relative paths and source URLs.

executionPolicy.execution: Sequential single-provider slots spanning the approved five-file/all-model combination; all completed slot evidence is reused.

outputLimitException.reason: A finite output ceiling is necessary for request-level budget reservations; native reasoning remains unchanged.

openAIBillingControls.accounting: Use complete provider cache components at reviewed Standard rates; otherwise conservatively value all input at 1.25x and label an upper bound. Require returned default tier; stop on ambiguity.

execution.costPolicy: Accounted cost includes reviewed-rate usage and the full unresolved HTTP 503 reservation. It is a conservative spending record, not an invoice reconciliation.
execution.retryPolicy: Reuse all completed journals. No automatic redispatch of failed slots. HTTP 503 retained its full 3.968-cent reservation and received one explicitly recorded recovery invocation within the same $5 approval; billing remains unresolved. Quota-zero and invalid-model responses were not retried.
